title: High-intent exact package and weekend viewing

transcript.message: Can share latest package and price? I’m free Saturday to view.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Pearlmont’s base prices start from RM328k, but that isn’t the current package price. Rebates depend on the unit category, floor and car-park allocation, so I’ll get the latest package and Saturday viewing arrangements confirmed before giving you a firm figure.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks for checking. Preferably Saturday around 2pm, for me and my wife. Could you confirm if that slot’s available and share the latest package before we come?

transcript.speaker: human
transcript.message: The current package and exact unit price aren’t verified in the available fixture, so I can’t confirm a latest package price. The fixture shows Saturday at 11:00 as available; it doesn’t verify 2:00 pm. Would 11:00 work for you and your wife?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Saturday 11am works for both of us. Please send the verified latest package and exact price before we come, and let me know once that’s confirmed.

judge.summary: The buyer was ready for an appointment from turn 0: he requested the latest package and price and said he was free to view Saturday. The AI correctly detected readiness and made an appropriately timed operational handoff with LOW sales work remaining. The human response did not complete the requested package/price verification or verify the requested 2:00 pm slot. The buyer then accepted the specific 11:00 am time that the simulator-only fixture showed as available, so the final appointment is confirmed under the stated acceptance criterion. The fixture is not Pearlmont factual Knowledge or evidence of real production availability.
judge.concrete_improvement_recommendation: On the initial message, acknowledge the viewing intent, state that the current exact package and live slot require verification, and ask one concise scheduling question for the preferred Saturday time and attendees. Then hand off those details for operational confirmation without quoting an unverified current price or implying simulator fixture data is real-world availability.
